description:
Score an output with an LLM judge on your own key: a 0..1 score, a rationale and the spend.

What it does. Calls Anthropic or OpenAI with IRIS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or IRIS_OPENAI_API_KEY; Iris never proxies. correctness needs expected, faithfulness needs source_material. The worst-case cost is checked against max_cost_usd first. Full detail: iris://capabilities.

When not to use it. For length, keyword, PII or cost checks (evaluate_output, free).

Returns. JSON: id, trace_id, score, passed, verdict, pass_threshold, self_reported_pass, disagreement, rationale, dimensions, model, provider, template, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd, latency_ms, raw_response_id, warnings.

Errors. IRIS_JUDGE_NOT_ENABLED (recovery has the steps); IRIS_JUDGE_UNKNOWN_MODEL; IRIS_UNKNOWN_TRACE; IRIS_BUDGET_EXCEEDED; IRIS_PROVIDER_ERROR. Failures return {"error":{code,message,recovery}} with isError; follow recovery.

Siblings. evaluate_output — the free deterministic path; verify_citations — citation grounding.

agent_model.description: The model that produced the output, for the same-family warning, when no linked trace records it

input.description: User question / prompt that produced the output (improves accuracy for helpfulness/safety)

max_cost_usd.description: Cost cap in USD for this call; defaults to IRIS_LLM_JUDGE_MAX_COST_USD_PER_EVAL or 0.25. The worst case (two attempts, full max_output_tokens) is computed before the call and refused if it exceeds the cap

model.description: Model ID. Supported: anthropic = claude-fable-5-1 | claude-opus-5 | claude-sonnet-5 (and the priced 4.x line); openai = gpt-5 | gpt-5-mini | gpt-4.1-mini (and the priced 4o, o3/o4 and retired o1 ids); an unknown id is refused with the full priced list. Required — cost varies a hundredfold across models

output.description: The agent output text to evaluate

source_material.description: Provided RAG sources (required for faithfulness template)

template.description: The question the judge answers; correctness needs expected, faithfulness and task_completed read source_material

trace_id.description: Link this evaluation to a stored trace (id from log_trace / get_traces); an unknown id is rejected BEFORE the judge is called

name: evaluate_with_llm_judge
title: Evaluate With LLM Judge
